# Skipped checks

The Comet text checker could not scan the 2.58 MiB vendored Frida header. No project test was skipped.

# Spec consistency

The implementation remains consistent with the specification; this failure records a tooling scan limit only.

The pinned header remains covered by SHA-256 verification, compilation, and native tests, but will be excluded from Comet's bounded text inspection with user confirmation.

# Conclusion

Fail for workflow recovery. Return to Build and narrow only the Comet text-inspection scope.
